gloss: to withdraw; to pull out; to be repatriated; to salvage

definitions.gloss: to withdraw; to pull out; to leave
definitions.explanation: To take people or things back from a place, or to go back and leave, as troops leaving a region or a company pulling out of a market. Used both transitively (〜を{引|ひ}き{揚|あ}げる) and intransitively (〜から{引|ひ}き{揚|あ}げる).

definitions.gloss: to return home; to be repatriated
definitions.explanation: To come back to one's home country from abroad, historically said of the Japanese who returned from former colonies and occupied areas after 1945.

definitions.gloss: to salvage; to raise (from the water)
definitions.explanation: To haul something up from the sea or a river, such as a sunken ship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{引|ひ}き{揚|あ}げた。
examples.english: The company pulled out of overseas markets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{皆|みな}→皆：01810_mina⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{揚|あ}げることにした。
examples.english: All the customers had left, so we decided to close up and leave too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{満州|まんしゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{引|ひ}き{揚|あ}げてきた。
examples.english: My grandfather came back from Manchuria after the war.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大陸|たいりく}→大陸：03400_tairiku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{日本|にっぽん}→日本：00320_nippon⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{引|ひ}き{揚|あ}げた。
examples.english: After the war, many people returned to Japan from the continent.

examples.japanese: {沈没船|ちんぼつせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{揚|あ}げる。
⟦{海底|かいてい}→海底：13287_kaitei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{引|ひ}き{揚|あ}げられた{壺|つぼ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ものだった。
examples.english: The jar raised from the seabed was a thousand years old.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧: to raise (prices, a rate); to lift up — use ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ for raising levels, ⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧ for withdrawing and repatriation. Pulling something up out of water may be written either way.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{揚|あ}げる: to withdraw troops
- ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{引|ひ}き{揚|あ}げる: to pull out of a market
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{揚|あ}げ{者|しゃ}→引き揚げ者：23653_hikiagesha⟧: repatriate (postwar returnee)
- {引|ひ}き{揚|あ}げ⟦{船|せん}→船：09875_sen⟧: repatriation ship
